item.scannable.chest_module.desc: Detects storage blocks (e.g. chests, barrels, shulker boxes).
item.scannable.spawner_module.desc:
Detects all spawners by default.
Filter via right-click on a spawner or mob.
Right-click air to configure, or use eggs.
item.scannable.lootr_module.desc:
Detects unopened Lootr loot.
Hides each container once you loot it.
